response.overview: Recently landed on the eerily quiet and apparently humanless planet Earth, we follow as ‘L O’ explores the empty streets of West London through the dark of the night; his journey guided by the intermittent sounds of a distant, singing voice. With a point-and-shoot camera in hand, the inquisitive ‘L O’ is seemingly fascinated by every minute detail and crevice passed while wandering these empty streets. After being steered along the desolate high road and through various empty sites, the voice finally draws L O towards its mysterious singer - who sits, calmly waiting, while delivering these melodies.
response.title: Roaming On Counter's Creek
